findings.title: Attributed guidance supports passage under load
findings.claim: The supplied attributed outlier lets measured fit meet supported and composed walking, with split-root pressure making the passage a movement through load and descent that remains held together.
findings.mechanism: قَدَّرَ at 87:3:2:1 carries the supplied fit facet; هَدَىٰ at 87:3:3:2 carries the supplied swaying-walk and calm-progress facets, while the packet's split-root mapping supplies structural breaking, heavy tread, and steep descent; their contact changes abstract guidance into an embodied support image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel guidance as assistance that preserves a vulnerable gait under demand, while the plain act of showing the way remains visible.
findings.containment: This is an attributed split-root embodied analogy, not the lexical meaning of هَدَىٰ and not a claim that the ayah names a literal traveler, load, collapse, or terrain.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinates, dominant and split-root branch records, and outlier containment are supplied, but the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound; the image remains attributed and bounded.
